PROC
PROC_GOB_Checkpoint_CheckPlayersInBouldersPath()
AND
IsDestroyed(S_GOB_Checkpoint_CMB_BoulderRope_3705c29b-50fb-405d-a197-bb4f01253ab2,0)
AND
QRY_GOB_Checkpoint_PlayersInBouldersPath()
AND
DB_GOB_Checkpoint_PlayersInBouldersPath(1)
AND
DB_GOB_Checkpoint_CanTargetRollingBoulder(_Goblin)
AND
DB_Is_InCombat((CHARACTER)_Goblin,_CmbId)
AND
QRY_CurrentCombatRoundIsGreaterThan(_CmbId,1)
THEN
AiAddInterestingItem(_Goblin,S_GOB_Checkpoint_CMB_BoulderRope_3705c29b-50fb-405d-a197-bb4f01253ab2);

PROC
PROC_LOW_LooseCollarsDestroy()
AND
DB_LOW_SteelWatchFoundry_LooseCollars(_Collar)
AND
CreateAtObject(QUEST_LOW_SteelWatchFoundry_DestroyedCollar_2071b74c-95b4-4490-91b7-cf5e250f22ab, _Collar, 0, 0, "", 1, _)
THEN
PROC_SetOnStage(_Collar, 0);

PROC

DB_BUGFIX_Marker("GUS-300205");

PROC

AND
NOT DB_OnlyOnce("ORI_Karlach_FoundSoulCoin")
AND
DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)ORI_Karlach_Knows_InfernalEngineExists_9b6d609a-2081-b5de-7dd6-12c425a8bc17)
AND
NOT DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)ORI_Karlach_Event_ReachedOverdrive_8c308560-7a87-49f5-ae52-143b48dd963b)
AND
TemplateGetCountInMagicPockets((ITEMROOT)LOOT_SoulCoin_8c68e68d-96d4-45d6-804c-5f31ac948ff3, _Avatar, _Count)
AND
_Count > 0
AND
QRY_OnlyOnce("ORI_Karlach_FoundSoulCoin")
THEN
PROC_RelationshipDialog((CHARACTER)S_Player_Karlach_2c76687d-93a2-477b-8b18-8a14b549304c, (DIALOGRESOURCE)Karlach_InParty_12459660-b66e-9b0b-9963-670e0993543d, (FLAG)ORI_Karlach_IPRD_SoulCoin_c5905063-6ab2-4491-b8df-360d0e7db346, S_Player_Karlach_2c76687d-93a2-477b-8b18-8a14b549304c, 0);
